resourceCoachSheet.title: Resource Coach Experiment Log — v1
resourceCoachSheet.contract: Existing immutable IDs are semantically cross-checked; only complete new observed IDs are staged. Rows whose partition, log_source or log_batch_id begins with 'archive' are refused: archive screenshots are transcribed only into the Archive_* tabs.

screenshotArchive.title: S208-S209 screenshot archive (18 Apr - 16 May 2026)
screenshotArchive.contract: Read-only. Grades, seasons, tier pairing and club-level readings are computed, never typed. The Drive tabs and the committed snapshot must hash identically; a sealed snapshot that drifts fails the run. Nothing is promoted into the run log; VERIFIED ordinary previews are listed as archive-partition candidates only.
